q: For a completely integrable Hamiltonian system with n degrees of freedom and n commuting first integrals, the Arnold-Liouville theorem states that compact connected level sets of the integrals are:
opts: n-dimensional tori on which the motion is quasi-periodic
exp: Arnold-Liouville: n commuting integrals in involution on a 2n-dimensional phase space, if the common level set is compact and connected, it is an n-torus carrying linear (quasi-periodic) flow.
